summary: Hardware diagnostic research profile. Candidate features: jog,pad,fader,eq,audio,usb. Software: Serato DJ Pro.
identityNotes: Research seed; the exact DJ-808 manual and Roland's 2024-03-29 rate-setting article enumerate 44.1, 48 and 96 kHz. The manual documents USB PC audio playback and controller MIDI through the PC port in standalone mode. Numeric USB audio input/output counts and USB stream bit depth remain unresolved: the manual distinguishes 24-bit A/D from 32-bit D/A conversion. Manual footer code 03 and copyright 2016 are document provenance, not firmware qualification. MIDI maps, USB IDs, class compliance, hardware revision, OS/firmware compatibility and physical performance remain unverified.

documents.title: DJ-808 Owner's Manual, English footer code 03
documents.notes: Checked 2026-11-18. Copyright 2016; footer code 03; no exact release date identified. Printed p. 3 describes USB computer audio playback; p. 21 describes PC-port MIDI in standalone mode; p. 22 enumerates 44.1/48/96 kHz. Main Specifications, p. 32, distinguish 24-bit A/D and 32-bit D/A; no generic USB stream bit depth or channel count is established. Document code is not firmware.

documents.notes: Updated 2024-03-29; checked 2026-11-18. The exact-model sampling-rate setting lists 44.1, 48 and 96 kHz. This support-document date is not a firmware revision or physical qualification.

tests.why: Test actual hardware response without inventing MIDI IDs, audio tolerances or HID mappings.

Exercise all jog controls or signal routes using MIDI monitor, DJ software or external measurement as appropriate.
Repeat, save evidence and distinguish unobservable from failed hardware.
